about_the_game:
Drunk or Baby The Party Game That Makes You Guess Twice

Is that chaotic behavior caused by a drunk adult or a confused baby? Welcome to Drunk or Baby, the hilarious multiplayer party game where your powers of deduction and your sense of humor are put to the test.

Perfect for game nights, parties, or online hangouts, Drunk or Baby pits players against bizarre real-life scenarios and asks them to vote: who did it a drunk person or a baby?

How It Works

Each round, a scenario is shown to all players. From fell asleep in the dog bed to tried to eat a remote control, you must guess whether it was caused by a toddler or a tipsy adult. Vote right, earn points, and compete to see who truly understands chaotic behavior best.

You can play solo, pass-and-play on one device, or hop online with friends. The game is fast, fun, and built to make everyone laugh.

Key Features

  • Party Game Chaos: Designed for 1-8 players, both local and online

  • 100+ Real-Life Scenarios: All inspired by the wild things babies and drunk people actually do

  • Vote-Based Gameplay: Make your choice, then see how others voted

  • Online Multiplayer: Host games with friends using room codes

  • Time-Based Rounds: Keep the pace moving with built-in timers

  • Random Rule Modifiers (Optional): Want blind rounds or forced answers? Toggle chaos on!

  • Mobile Version Coming Soon: Play anywhere, any time

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+, Windows 10, or later (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent DX10-compatible GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Local play requires keyboard/mouse or shared controller; Online requires stable network

short_description: A chaotic party game where 1-8 players guess whether bizarre real-life scenarios were caused by a drunk adult or a baby, using deduction, voting, and laughter to win.
